status: development pilot (gate), NOT confirmatory: the 147 J3 cases were used for all diagnostics
model: gemini-3.8-flash (LLM-GATEWAY-1.example; resume on vps gemini-3.8-flash-high if the endpoint fails, recorded per file)
method_MS: 1) candidates = model's own free-text intermediates (S and G of the inert-knowledge probe), unique by sigma key, endpoint species removed; 2) M = executable PGL mechanism (E prompt + audit) with candidates listed as 'possible intermediates, some may be incorrect'; 3) pairwise judge E vs M in both orders, M taken only if preferred in both
compute_matched_baseline_DS: same judge between E and E_r2 (E_r2 taken only if preferred in both orders)

gate.primary: sigma-L1 MS - DS >= +6 pp with case-clustered 95% CI excluding 0
required_also: spurious transient bonds per case MS - DS <= +0.2
gate.pass: freeze method, add gpt-6-luna, pre-register confirmation on unused data (Fukuyama T3, oMe-Gold, fresh literature set)
gate.fail: inspect M alone vs MS (judge failure vs candidate failure) before any redesign; no claim from this set

secondary: M alone (no judge) vs E and DS
